scope: Nine generated single-entity or mixed AC1021 scratch files with the explicit default material and plotstyle providers, plus four sampled LINE provider combinations. No general DWG writer support claim.

producer.source_revision: 6f294fc7 (same src tree as 882350c8; latter only changes README.md)
producer.reproduction: Compile with c++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror -Isrc -Itests tools/probe_ac1021_geometry_matrix.cpp build-gcc/libdxfrw.a -o <scratch>/producer. Run producer <mode> <new-path.dwg>; the optional third and fourth arguments select material and plotstyle opt-ins as 0 or 1. All nine files were regenerated after the VPORT commit and matched the converted originals byte for byte.

geometry_contract.ARC: OCS center (10,11,3), radius 4, angles 20 and 115 degrees
geometry_contract.normals: default (0,0,1), tilt (0,1,0), negative (0,0,-1); tilted and negative circles thickness 1.25 and arcs 0.5
geometry_contract.mixed: one LINE, one default CIRCLE, one default ARC

producer_source_control.author: tools/author_ac1021_geometry_matrix.py
producer_source_control.result: ODA scratch DXF to AC1021 DWG to DXF succeeded with no .err and no captured warnings. Source contains all eight entity/normal variants and independent semantic checks passed. The author was subsequently hardened to refuse overwriting an existing destination; drawing values are unchanged.

conversion.interpretation: A zero process status is not acceptance: inspect DXF, .err and captured log. The four successful files had DXF and no .err or captured warning output. The five unsuccessful files had only .err; all listed earlier object warnings before fatal failure. Physical ODA conversion lineage is the separately observed scratch run, not established by the peer audit tool.

limits: Scratch files live under /private/tmp/ac1021-geometry-matrix; no DWG or DXF fixtures are committed.
These are observed results for explicitly selected geometry, flags and one tool version. The LINE opt-in factorial is not proof that those settings are necessary for all drawings.

The separately investigated POINT/CIRCLE absent-string footer correction is in progress. This receipt records pre-fix behavior at 6f294fc7; failed objects remain peer-readback observations, not ODA acceptance.
